parent_reference.rule: This ETH test cannot rescue, rewrite, or promote the BTC result.

mechanism: Identical to BTC PCU: extreme funding tail plus unusually high 24h aggregate-open-interest expansion identifies crowded leveraged positioning; test a 24h contrarian unwind.

coverage_gate.full: at least 46 months at >=95% daily metrics coverage and >=11 full common months in every year, with monthly funding and 1h klines
coverage_gate.limited: at least 36 months at >=80% daily metrics coverage and >=8 usable common months in every year

anti_tuning: No threshold, horizon, cost, rolling history, sign, or overlap rule may differ from BTC PCU.
No BTC outcome may be combined with ETH to retroactively change the BTC verdict.
